rules_evaluated.rule_lead: No stale markers, no "fixed" retrospectives, no session biography.
rules_evaluated.evidence: L25 maintainer block, '**Slides-only pass (2026-07-02, unaudited):**' note: 'covered region DELETED (Path A). Per-passage verdicts: three-shapes prose sections CONVERTED to one slide ... per-shape tail lines ... SUBSUMED by slide 2's first bullet · "Each is real; each is downstream" softener CUT · ticket-pair paragraph CUT (...) · "M3 starts with a feature you're shipping" bridge CUT (...) · intro line KEPT as the closer's setup lede.' Five transition verbs (DELETED, CONVERTED, SUBSUMED, CUT x3, KEPT) narrate a completed edit rather than stating current state -- the rule's own tense test ('would a reader who never saw the previous version lose anything actionable if the clause vanished?') answers no for most of this clause chain: the standing constraint it half-repeats already stands alone at L39/L21 (Standing constraint block), and the current file shape is already stated plainly at the end of the same line ('File is now lede + two slides.'). The rule's own exception protects one piece of this note, not all of it: the ticket-pair clause names a live dependency ('if the cull reverses, the exercise carries the connection') that would otherwise need re-deriving, so that clause is the kind of empirical finding the rule explicitly keeps. The mechanical passing-condition grep the rule supplies (settled|retired|no longer|used to be|was changed to|previously|swapped|dropped|renamed, deliberately excluding 'cut') returns 0 hits, which is expected -- this note's verbs (DELETED/CONVERTED/SUBSUMED/CUT/KEPT) aren't in that narrower list, so the grep alone under-reports it; the rule is explicit that grep is the second check, tense is first.
rules_evaluated.fix_hint: Keep the dated header and the ticket-pair dependency clause (it's a live finding, not journey); recast the rest as present-tense state -- e.g. what the file now covers and what the exercise still owns -- and drop the per-clause DELETED/CONVERTED/SUBSUMED/CUT/KEPT verdict trail, since the standing constraint and current shape are already stated elsewhere in the block.
